studio.aiIntro: Connect your models and shape how each assistant works.
studio.rolePromptHelp: Your default instructions for this role. Workflow, course, and step instructions add context. Preview the combined prompt before each run.
studio.discardMessage: Your changes have not been saved. Discard them and leave?
studio.keepKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key
studio.keyPrivacy: Keys stay in this profile’s encrypted database on this device. They are never included in workflow exports or model prompts.
studio.noConnections: Add a local endpoint or a cloud connection to assign models to roles.
studio.compatibility: Connect an OpenAI-compatible text API, including Ollama or LM Studio. Use a /v1 base URL. Media roles currently produce briefs, scripts, and storyboards; media generation adapters are not installed.
studio.workflowIntro: Reusable steps with your models, instructions, and a final instructor review.
studio.workflowPromptHelp: Describe the teaching style, output format, and constraints shared by every step.
studio.approvalCheckpoint: Instructor review is always required before generated content changes a lesson.
studio.stepPromptHelp: Tailor this step without changing the role’s defaults. Previous step outputs are supplied as reference material.
studio.runFromLesson: Run a saved workflow from a text lesson in the course creator.
studio.sharedContext: Review material shared with the models
studio.runDisclosure: Starting sends the selected lesson, sources, and earlier step outputs to the configured models. Cloud calls may incur provider charges. Each request is limited to 4,096 output tokens. No automatic fallback or retry is used.
studio.reviewDraft: Review and edit the proposed lesson
studio.applyHelp: Approval replaces this lesson’s saved text. Newer edits cause a conflict. You can undo the change until the lesson is edited again.
studio.briefHelp: Give authoring workflows a shared starting point.
studio.outcome: What will learners be able to do?
studio.coursePromptHelp: Set your teaching style, tone, terminology, and accessibility expectations for this course.
studio.sourceHelp: Add source excerpts and teaching notes. Only selected sources are sent to authoring models. These private notes are not included in the published course.
studio.reviewHelp: Check explanations, references, practice, and assessment answers before publishing.
studio.releaseReviewed: I have reviewed the lessons, source references, accessibility, and assessment content in this release.
studio.prepareHelp: Review the effective prompts, model handoffs, and shared material before starting. Save the lesson editor before preparing a run.
studio.saveLessonFirst: Save the current lesson before preparing a workflow.
studio.assistantIntro: Connect an external MCP assistant to your course drafts. You choose its permissions; proposals wait for your approval in Workflows → Runs.
studio.assistantUnavailable: Local assistant access is unavailable. It currently requires Alexandria running on macOS or Linux.
studio.assistantReadScope: Allow reading your course titles, text lessons, instructor instructions and selected source notes.
studio.assistantProposeScope: Also allow submitting lesson proposals for my review.
studio.assistantExpiry: Access expires after one hour and is revoked when you lock, switch profiles or close Alexandria. Your assistant may send the draft content to its model provider.
studio.assistantSetup: Add this server configuration to your MCP client.
studio.assistantSetupHelp: Use the full path to the built alexandria-mcp executable if it is not on your PATH. Keep Alexandria open. The private connection file contains the grant; do not share it.
studio.learnerFeedbackHelp: Review lesson ratings and comments, then start an improvement workflow with that feedback in its visible context.
studio.improvePrompt: Improve this item using the learner feedback in the reference context. Preserve accurate material and address repeated clarity problems.
studio.noLearnerFeedback: No learner feedback has reached this profile yet.
studio.courseSettingsHelp: Manage course details and learner assistance in one place.
studio.enableTutorHelp: Learners can use their own local model or cloud API key on published text lessons. The tutor stays off during assessments.
studio.tutorGuidance: How should the tutor guide learners?
studio.tutorSocratic: Socratic · guide with questions and progressive hints
studio.tutorDirect: Direct · explain clearly, then check understanding
studio.tutorPromptHelp: This prompt is published with the course so every learner's model follows your teaching approach. Do not put secrets in it.
